info.text:
46% of what Six Flags guests spend in-park isn't admission.

In 2025, the average guest spent $61.90 a visit: $33.41 admission, $28.49 (46%) on food, games and extras.
Six Flags books a pass over the visits it expects. Example: a $120 pass with 6 expected visits = $20 of admission per trip.
Season-pass visits rose 10% at the same parks in Q2 2026, and deferred revenue (advance sales, mostly passes) was $431 million as of June 28, 2026.

Sources: Six Flags 2025 Form 10-K and Q4 2025 / Q2 2026 earnings releases.
